text: 你们两人都没有喊叫，或许是太过惊讶。前方不远处，一群怪异生物正在劳作，它们用灵巧的爪子操纵机器，吸取岩石上的矿物沉积物。这些生物像粉红色、五英尺高的甲壳动物，身上长着真菌。它们肯定不是这颗星球的原住民。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 477
text: Neither of you cry out; perhaps you’re too astonished to do so. A short distance up ahead, a band of bizarre creatures toil, using machines held in delicate claws to suck up mineral deposits precipitated on the rocks. These entities resemble pink, five-foot-high crustaceans infested with fungoid growths. They surely could not have originated on this planet.
